text:
ash: Quick question — on console analytics: can we make per-model saved filters that automatically inherit route-level quota filters when opened from a route? idea: show a small badge 'quota scope: route/<route-name>' when a route's quota is applied. Should saved queries be scoped or global?
maria: my 2c: saved queries should have an explicit scope enum: global / org / route / personal. If user saves while viewing a route, default to route scope but let them change it. show scope in dropdown.
ben (data): +1. also, for stability we should let saved queries optionally pin to a model version (pinned_model_version) so rollouts don't silently change results. fallback rules if pinned version not available.
sophie: UX: add a tiny 'inherit route filters' checkbox in the save modal. and permission toggle: public / team / private. when a route-scoped query is shared, the recipient must have route access or we show 'no access — create copy' CTA.
devex: From API side here's a minimal contract proposal:
```json
POST /v1/analytics/saved_queries
{
  "query": "model: redwood-7b filter: status:ok",
  "scope": "route", // route|org|global|personal
  "inherit_route_filters": true,
  "pinned_model_version": "redwood-7b@v1.2.0"
}
```
Also the query builder should render applied quota filters as read-only tags so users know what's being forced by the route.
ash: @ops-bot can we expose quotas via telemetry API so console can render badge + used/limit?
ops-bot: quota-service has GET /v1/quotas?route_id=<id> -> { "limit": 1000000, "window": "monthly", "used": 256432 }. will add CORS and a short TTL cache for the console. ETA ~2d.
maria: sharing behavior note: shared links should preserve scope + pinned version. if recipient lacks access, they get a clear error and option to duplicate as personal. avoid leaking route membership.
ben (data): also want a tiny cost-preview in the saved query card: median tokens per req, estimated tokens/month if run at current traffic. helps teams understand cost impact before applying.
sophie: mockup uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/console-saved-queries — shows badge, scope pill, and 'inherit route filters' toggle.
dash: one more idea — quick-presets under each model row on the route page (chips). show top 4 presets + a 'manage' link that opens saved queries filtered to route scope.
devex: i'll wire up the modal and API. plan: add scope & inherit flag to schema, migration to populate scope=route when saved from route page, and endpoint to resolve effective filters (apply route quota tags). will open PR and link.
product-bot: Created ticket #PROD-1123 "Saved query scopes + quota-aware badges" assigned to @devex.
nash: :thumbsup: let's ship an MVP: scope enum + inherit flag + quota badge + share behavior. followups: pin model version, cost preview, and quick-presets chips.
